# @oge-ui/react-gantt

> React Gantt chart: virtualized task tree pane + timeline chart, summary/milestone/baseline bars, FS/SS/FF/SF dependency arrows, critical path, auto-scheduling on work calendars, resources and workload, drag editing with Escape-cancel, snapshot undo/redo, built-in context menu and task dialog, Excel/PDF/PNG export — running the same @oge-ui/gantt-engine controller and stylesheet as the Angular Gantt package.
>
> This package is commercially licensed — unlike the rest of the suite, it is not MIT. See https://www.ogeui.com/license before shipping it.

Part of OGE UI v1.1.3.
Docs and live demos: https://www.ogeui.com/components/gantt
Whole-suite reference: https://www.ogeui.com/llms-full.txt

```sh
npm i @oge-ui/react-gantt
```

## Writing OGE React code

Follow these rules and generated code compiles on the first try.

1. **These are plain React components.** Import the component and render it:
   `import { OgeButton } from '@oge-ui/react-buttons'`. There is no module, no
   provider requirement and no `imports` array — that is the Angular package.
2. **Import the stylesheet once, at your app entry.**
   `import '@oge-ui/react-buttons/styles.css'`. Components ship no inline
   styles; without this import they render unstyled.
3. **Props are plain props, not signals.** Write `text="Save"`,
   `severity="accent"`, `disabled`. Never call them (`text()`), and never use
   `[prop]`/`[(prop)]` binding syntax — that is Angular template syntax.
4. **Modes are string unions, never enums.** Write the literal:
   `severity="danger"`, `stylingMode="outlined"`, `size="sm"`,
   `selectionMode="single"`. There is no `OgeButtonSeverity.Danger`.
5. **Events are `on*` callbacks taking the payload directly** —
   `onClick={(event) => …}`, `onActionDone={(result) => …}`,
   `onSelectionChange={(change) => …}`. Note this is the mirror image of the
   Angular naming rule: there, outputs drop the `on` prefix; here React's
   convention wins, and the payload is the argument rather than an event object.
6. **Two-way state is the controlled/uncontrolled pair.** Pass `selectedKeys`
   plus `onSelectionChange` to control it yourself, or `defaultSelectedKeys`
   to let the component own it. Same for the button's `loading` /
   `onLoadingChange`.
7. **App-wide defaults and every user-facing string** come from a context
   provider: `<OgeButtonsConfigProvider config={{ clickGuardMs: 300,
   messages: { loading: 'Yükleniyor' } }}>`. That is how localization works;
   there is no i18n dependency. Per-instance overrides use the `messages` prop.
8. **Styling is CSS custom properties**, all prefixed `--oge-`, identical to
   the Angular packages — the two render layers share one stylesheet. Never
   target internal class names; override the token.
9. **Slots are props that take nodes**, not children with directives:
   `icon={<SaveIcon />}`. Free `children` render inside the button after the
   label.
10. **Server components:** every component is a client component
    (`'use client'` is already in the package). Import them from a client
    component, or mark your own file `'use client'`.

### Theming

```css
:root {
  --oge-accent: #4f46e5;   /* selection, focus, primary actions */
  --oge-radius-lg: 10px;
}
```

The theme stylesheets are shared with the Angular packages and ship in
`@oge-ui/core` (installed with every package; add it directly under pnpm):
`@oge-ui/core/themes/dark.css` (then `class="oge-theme-dark"` or
`data-oge-theme="dark"` on `<html>` or any subtree; `"auto"` follows
`prefers-color-scheme`), plus the `tailwind.css` and `bootstrap.css`
bridges.

## Common mistakes

Predictable wrong guesses, and what to write instead.

| Wrong | Right |
| --- | --- |
| `import { OgeButton } from '@oge-ui/buttons'` | `from '@oge-ui/react-buttons'` — the unprefixed package is Angular |
| `imports: [OgeButton]` | nothing — just render `<OgeButton />` |
| `[text]="label"` / `[(loading)]="busy"` | `text={label}` / `loading={busy} onLoadingChange={setBusy}` |
| `(clicked)="save()"` | `onClick={save}` |
| `onClick={(e) => e.cancel = true}` | there is no cancelable pre-event on the React buttons |
| `severity={OgeButtonSeverity.Danger}` | `severity="danger"` |
| forgetting the stylesheet | `import '@oge-ui/react-buttons/styles.css'` once at the app entry |
| `<OgeButton icon="save" />` | `icon={<SaveIcon />}` — slots take nodes |
| `::part` / overriding `.oge-button-native` | override a `--oge-*` token |
| rendering it from a server component | mark the file `'use client'` |

## API reference

### <OgeGantt>

#### Properties

_Data_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tasks` | `readonly T[]` | `[]` | Task items — a plain array, copied into an internal working set; the prop is never mutated. Edits surface through the past-tense callbacks. A new array reference resets the working set and the undo history. |
| `dependencies` | `readonly D[]` | `[]` | Dependency links between tasks; same working-set semantics as `tasks`. |
| `keyExpr / parentKeyExpr / titleExpr / startExpr / endExpr / progressExpr / colorExpr` | `string \| ((item: T) => unknown)` | `'id' / 'parentId' / 'title' / 'start' / 'end' / 'progress' / 'color'` | Task field mapping: names (dotted paths reach nested objects) or getter functions. String dates parse as _local_ wall time and write back in the same storage shape. |
| `baselineStartExpr / baselineEndExpr` | `string \| ((item: T) => unknown)` | `'baselineStart' / 'baselineEnd'` | Baseline plan fields — tasks with both render the original plan as a slim bar under the live bar. |
| `dependencyKeyExpr / predecessorKeyExpr / successorKeyExpr / dependencyTypeExpr` | `string \| ((item: D) => unknown)` | `'id' / 'predecessorId' / 'successorId' / 'type'` | Dependency field mapping. Types are `'FS' \| 'SS' \| 'FF' \| 'SF'` (dx numeric codes 0–3 also parse); missing type means FS. |
| `resources` | `readonly OgeGanttResource[]` | `[]` | Resource choices (`{ id, text, color?, calendar? }`): labels next to the bars, the multi-assignment tag editor in the task dialog, the workload band rows — and a resource's own `calendar` overrides `workCalendar` for its tasks (first assigned resource with a calendar wins). |
| `resourceIdExpr` | `string \| ((item: T) => unknown)` | `'resourceId'` | The task's assigned resource field — a single id or an array of ids (multi-assignment). Write-back preserves the storage shape. |
| `dependencyLagExpr / dependencyLagUnitExpr` | `string \| ((item: D) => unknown)` | `'lag' / 'lagUnit'` | Link **lag / lead**: an amount (negative = lead) and its unit, `'days'` (working days on a `workCalendar`) or `'hours'`. Drawn as a `+2d` badge on the arrow, honoured by auto-scheduling for all four link types, edited in the dependency editor (double-click an arrow, or Enter on a clicked one) and in the `predecessors` column (`3FS+2d`). |
| `manuallyScheduledExpr` | `string \| ((item: T) => unknown)` | `'manuallyScheduled'` | Per-task scheduling mode — `true` pins the task: auto-scheduling never moves it, and a link it breaks is reported as a `dependency` conflict. Bars draw a hatched pattern. |
| `constraintTypeExpr / constraintDateExpr` | `string \| ((item: T) => unknown)` | `'constraintType' / 'constraintDate'` | Task constraint (MS Project vocabulary): `'ASAP' \| 'ALAP' \| 'SNET' \| 'SNLT' \| 'FNET' \| 'FNLT' \| 'MSO' \| 'MFO'` and its date. SNET/FNET set a floor, MSO/MFO pin the task, SNLT/FNLT cap it; links win over SNLT/FNLT/MSO and the violation is reported. ALAP slides the task as late as its successors allow (backward pass). A dated type without a date reads as ASAP. |
| `deadlineExpr` | `string \| ((item: T) => unknown)` | `'deadline'` | Target finish: a flag marker on the bar row, an _overdue_ state (and a `deadline` conflict) when the task ends later. |
| `segmentsExpr` | `string \| ((item: T) => unknown)` | `'segments'` | Split tasks: `[{ start, end }, …]` — two or more pieces draw as separate bars joined by a dotted line; the task spans its pieces. Moving drags every piece; resizing moves the first piece's start or the last piece's end. |
| `baselinesExpr` | `string \| ((item: T) => unknown)` | `'baselines'` | Several baselines: `[{ start, end }, …]`, index = baseline number − 1. Wins over `baselineStartExpr`/`baselineEndExpr` (which remain baseline 1). The toolbar shows a chooser when a task carries more than one. |
| `unitsExpr / effortExpr` | `string \| ((item: T) => unknown)` | `'units' / 'effort'` | Assignment **units** in % (a number for every assigned resource, an array aligned with the resource ids, or an id-keyed map; default 100) and work in hours (`effortDriven`). |

_Appearance & behavior_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scaleType / defaultScaleType` | `'hours' \| 'days' \| 'weeks' \| 'months' \| 'quarters' \| 'years'` | `'days'` | Timeline scale — calendar-true ticks (real month lengths, DST-safe). Controlled when `scaleType` is set (pair it with `onScaleTypeChange`); `defaultScaleType` seeds the uncontrolled state. The toolbar zoom and zoom-to-fit write it. |
| `firstDayOfWeek` | `number \| undefined` | `—` | First day of week (0 = Sunday) for the weeks scale; `undefined` resolves from the locale. |
| `columns` | `readonly OgeGanttColumn[]` | `title / start / end / duration` | Task-list columns: built-in fields (`title`, `start`, `end`, `duration`, `progress`, `wbs`, `predecessors`, `totalSlack`, `freeSlack`, `constraint`, `deadline`, `resources`, `units`, `effort`) or any data field, with optional `header`, `widthPx`, `format`, `editor` (`false` = read-only), `allowSorting` and `frozen` (pinned to the start edge, frozen columns lead). |
| `taskListWidth` | `number` | `360` | Width (px) of the task pane; the splitter between the panes drags it, and a new value re-applies. |
| `taskTitlePosition` | `'inside' \| 'outside' \| 'none'` | `'inside'` | Where the task title renders relative to its bar. |
| `showDependencies / showRowLines` | `boolean` | `true` | Dependency arrows / horizontal row guides. |
| `showCriticalPath` | `boolean` | `false` | Outlines the zero-slack chain (backward-pass latest-finish relaxation over all four link types). |
| `weekendsHighlighted / holidays` | `boolean / readonly Date[]` | `true / []` | Off-day shading on the days scale. |
| `weekendDays` | `readonly number[] \| undefined` | `—` | Weekend days (0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday) `weekendsHighlighted` shades. `undefined` resolves from the locale via `Intl.Locale#getWeekInfo()` (Friday + Saturday in `he-IL`), falling back to Saturday + Sunday. A `workCalendar` takes precedence. |
| `workCalendar` | `OgeGanttWorkCalendar \| null` | `null` | Work-time calendar (`{ workingDays?, holidays? }`, 0 = Sunday): shades every off day and makes auto-scheduling roll pushed starts onto working days, preserving durations in _working_ days. The `holidays` prop merges in; per-resource `calendar`s override it per task. |
| `showResourceWorkload` | `boolean` | `false` | Renders the per-resource workload band under the chart: merged assignment segments per resource, overallocated stretches in the danger color. |
| `stripLines` | `readonly OgeGanttStripLine[]` | `[]` | Vertical markers: `{ start, end?, label?, color? }` — a line without `end`, a shaded range with it. |
| `timeZone` | `string \| undefined` | `undefined` | The display zone (IANA, e.g. `'America/New_York'`); unset = the browser’s. Stored dates stay **instants**: the bars, the scale, the today marker, the progress line, strip lines and the work calendar’s working days follow this zone’s clocks (core’s `Intl` offset math — DST-exact, no time-zone database), and every edit, drag and dialog save writes the instant back. |
| `locale` | `string \| undefined` | `—` | BCP 47 locale for every `Intl` format; defaults to the provider locale, then the browser locale. |
| `messages` | `Partial<OgeGanttMessages>` | `{}` | Per-instance message overrides, merged over the provider config per top-level block. |
| `rtlEnabled` | `boolean \| undefined` | `undefined` | Right-to-left layout: the task tree moves to the right, the timeline runs from right to left (dependency arrows, baselines, today line and drag tip included), pointer drags and the splitter invert their direction and the Left/Right keys mirror — Left expands a summary, Alt+Shift+Left indents and Ctrl+Left moves a bar later. Unset follows the page: the computed `direction` or the nearest `dir` attribute, read after the first render and kept current while it changes; an explicit value also sets `dir` on the host. The built-in context menu opens towards the inline-start side of the pointer and its back arrow mirrors (Right closes it in RTL), and the PNG / PDF exports mirror the picture while the Excel export writes a right-to-left sheet (MS Project XML is direction-neutral data). |
| `selectedTaskKey / defaultSelectedTaskKey` | `RowKey \| null` | `null` | The selected task. Controlled when `selectedTaskKey` is set (pair it with `onSelectedTaskKeyChange`); `defaultSelectedTaskKey` seeds the uncontrolled state and is applied at mount. |
| `className / style` | `string / CSSProperties` | `—` | Applied to the `.oge-gantt` host — give it a height (the body scrolls inside it). |

_Scheduling_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `autoScheduling` | `boolean` | `false` | Project-level auto-scheduling: after every edit the engine places each auto-scheduled task at the earliest date its links (with lag) and constraint allow — **moving tasks earlier as well as later** — then slides ALAP tasks late (backward pass). Manually scheduled tasks stay put. `scheduleProject()` runs it on demand. |
| `projectStart` | `Date \| null` | `null` | Where unlinked ASAP tasks start while auto-scheduling; `null` keeps their current start (only links and constraints move a task). |
| `baselineIndex / defaultBaselineIndex` | `number` | `0` | Which baseline renders (0-based); `-1` hides baselines. Controlled when provided; the toolbar chooser calls `onBaselineIndexChange`. |
| `showProgressLine / statusDate` | `boolean / Date \| null` | `false / null` | The progress line: a zig-zag through every visible row from the status date to the point each started task's progress has reached (status date default: today). |
| `showRollups` | `boolean` | `false` | Draws every child milestone onto its summary bar (useful when the summary is collapsed). |
| `zoomPresets` | `readonly OgeGanttZoomPreset[] \| null` | `null` | The toolbar's scale chooser: `{ scaleType, tickWidth?, label? }` entries; `null` lists one per scale (hours … years). |

_Task list_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `inlineEditing` | `boolean` | `false` | Edits task-list cells in place: double-click a cell or press **F2** on a row; Enter commits, Escape cancels, Tab / Shift+Tab commit and move along the row. Text, date, number, duration (days) and predecessor (`3FS+2d, 5SS`) editors; summaries keep their rolled-up dates read-only. Every commit is one undoable update through the cancelable pipeline. |
| `allowSorting` | `boolean` | `false` | Header click / Enter sorts (ascending → descending → off) — siblings within each parent, WBS numbers keep the store order. `aria-sort` on the header. |
| `allowColumnResizing / allowColumnReordering` | `boolean` | `false` | Header edge drag or **Alt+Left/Right** (Shift: 1px) resizes a column; header drag or **Ctrl+Shift+Left/Right** moves it. Headers become one roving tab stop (Left/Right between them, Down into the rows). |
| `filterRow / searchPanel` | `boolean` | `false` | A filter row under the headers (per column) and a toolbar search box (any column): fold-insensitive “contains” on the cell text; matches keep their ancestors and open collapsed summaries. |
| `selectionMode` | `'single' \| 'multiple'` | `'single'` | `'multiple'`: Ctrl/Cmd-click toggles, Shift-click and Shift+Up/Down extend, Ctrl+Space toggles, Ctrl+A selects all; Delete, Alt+Shift+Left/Right and the context menu act on the whole selection as **one undo step**. |
| `selectedTaskKeys / defaultSelectedTaskKeys` | `readonly RowKey[]` | `[]` | Every selected key in multiple mode (the primary row is `selectedTaskKey`). Controlled when provided. |

_Resources & views_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `effortDriven / hoursPerDay` | `boolean / number` | `false / 8` | Effort-driven scheduling: changing a task's resources, units or work recomputes its finish as `work ÷ (hoursPerDay × Σ units)` in working days. |
| `showResourceHistogram` | `boolean` | `false` | Per-resource utilization rows under the chart: one bar per timeline period (units × overlap), a dashed capacity line (`OgeGanttResource.capacity`, default 100%), over-allocated periods in the danger colour; each row's accessible name summarizes the peak and the periods over capacity. |
| `viewMode / defaultViewMode` | `'tasks' \| 'resources'` | `'tasks'` | `'resources'` regroups the rows by resource (an _Unassigned_ group last); assignment rows edit the real task. The toolbar toggle (shown when `resources` exist) calls `onViewModeChange`. |

_Editing gates_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `editingEnabled` | `boolean` | `true` | Master editing switch (dx `editing.enabled`). |
| `allowTaskAdding / allowTaskUpdating / allowTaskDeleting / allowDependencyAdding / allowDependencyDeleting` | `boolean` | `true` | Per-capability editing gates. |
| `readOnly` | `boolean` | `false` | **Display-only shorthand**: equivalent to `editingEnabled={false}`, hides every editing affordance. |

_Render props_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `renderTask` | `(context: OgeGanttTaskRenderContext<T>) => ReactNode` | Replaces the bar's title content; context `{ task }` — the React form of `*ogeGanttTaskTemplate`. |
| `renderTooltip` | `(context: OgeGanttTooltipRenderContext<T>) => ReactNode` | Replaces the hover tooltip's content (default: title, dates + duration, progress, resources); context `{ task }` — the React form of `*ogeGanttTooltipTemplate`. |

#### Methods

_Handle (ref)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `insertTask(taskData) / updateTask(taskData, patch) / deleteTask(taskData)` | `void` | Programmatic CRUD through the same cancelable pipelines as interactive editing — one undo step each. |
| `insertDependency(predecessorKey, successorKey, type?, options?) / deleteDependency(dependencyData)` | `void` | Guarded link CRUD; inserting runs the same cycle check as interactive drawing and takes an optional `{ lag, lagUnit }`. |
| `undo() / redo()` | `void` | Snapshot history — every applied edit, drags included, is exactly one step (depth: config `undoLimit`). |
| `zoomIn() / zoomOut() / zoomToFit()` | `void` | Steps the scale (hours ⇄ days ⇄ weeks ⇄ months ⇄ quarters ⇄ years) / picks the finest scale that fits the whole plan. Each reports through `onScaleTypeChange`. |
| `scrollToDate(date)` | `void` | Scrolls the chart so `date` is in view. |
| `expandAll() / collapseAll() / expandAllToLevel(level) / expandToTask(key)` | `void` | Tree expansion control; `expandToTask` also focuses and reveals the row. |
| `showTaskDetailsDialog(taskData?)` | `void` | Opens the task dialog — edit form for the given task, prefilled create form without one. |
| `indentTask(task) / outdentTask(task)` | `void` | Reparents through the guarded update pipeline: indent makes the task a child of its previous sibling, outdent lifts it to the grandparent. Also on the built-in context menu and **Alt+Shift+Left/Right** on the focused row. |
| `focus()` | `void` | Focuses the task tree (roving row). |
| `getExportData()` | `OgeGanttExportData<T>` | Snapshot for the exporters: every task in tree order (collapse ignored), the resolved columns with pane-identical formatting, the chart range and the critical-path keys. |

_Scheduling, task list & selection_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `scheduleProject()` | `void` | Runs the scheduling engine now — even with `autoScheduling` off — as one undo step. |
| `updateDependency(dependencyData, patch)` | `void` | Updates a link's fields (type, lag, lag unit…) through the cancelable `dependencyUpdating` pipeline; auto-scheduling re-runs. |
| `getTaskSlack(key)` | `OgeGanttSlack \| null` | Total and free slack of a leaf task in days (working days on a calendar) — also the `totalSlack` / `freeSlack` columns. |
| `setBaseline(index?)` | `void` | Saves every leaf task's current dates as baseline `index` (0-based, default 0) — MS Project “Set Baseline”, one undo step. |
| `applyZoomPreset(index)` | `void` | Applies a zoom preset (scale + tick width) by index. |
| `sortBy(field, direction?) / setFilter(field, text) / setSearchText(text) / clearFilters()` | `void` | Programmatic sort (`null` clears), filter-row text and search. |
| `setColumnWidth(field, widthPx) / moveColumn(field, toIndex)` | `void` | Column width (clamped 40–600px) and order — the same paths as the header gestures, with their events. |
| `editCell(task, field?)` | `boolean` | Opens the inline editor on a cell (unset field = the first editable one); `false` when the cell is read-only. |
| `getSelectedTasks() / selectAll() / clearSelection()` | `OgeGanttTask<T>[] / void` | The multi-selection in tree order, select every visible task, clear. |
| `deleteTasks(items) / indentTasks(tasks) / outdentTasks(tasks)` | `void` | Bulk edits — each one undo step and one plural announcement. |

_Export entry points (lazy, optional peers)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `exportGanttToExcel(handle, options?) / buildGanttExcelWorkbook(data, options?)` | `@oge-ui/react-gantt/export-excel` | Lazy Excel export (`exceljs` peer) from the Gantt's `ref` handle: the task tree as a typed worksheet — indented titles, bold summary rows, real Date cells, an appended resource column; a right-to-left sheet when the Gantt is RTL (`rtl` option overrides). The builder is the same one the Angular entry re-exports. |
| `exportGanttToPdf(handle, options?) / buildGanttPdfDocument(data, options?)` | `@oge-ui/react-gantt/export-pdf` | Lazy PDF export (`jspdf` peer): the chart drawn as vector graphics — scale header, bars with progress fill, summary brackets, milestone diamonds, optional critical-path outlining, multi-page pagination. An RTL Gantt exports mirrored — title column on the right, timeline running right to left, right-aligned text — unless `rtl: false` is passed. Text outside WinAnsi (Turkish `ğ ş ı İ`, Central European, Greek, Cyrillic) needs a Unicode TrueType `font` — per export, or once for every PDF via `setOgePdfDefaultFont({ family, normal, bold })` from `@oge-ui/behavior`; without one the built-in Helvetica cannot draw it (a dev-mode warning says so). |
| `exportGanttToPng(handle, options?) / buildGanttCanvas(data, options?)` | `@oge-ui/react-gantt/export-image` | Lazy PNG export with **no dependencies** — plain canvas drawing of the same chart, mirrored for an RTL Gantt like the PDF (`rtl` option overrides). |
| `exportGanttToMsProject(handle, options?) / importMsProjectXml(xml)` | `@oge-ui/react-gantt/export-msproject` | MS Project XML (MSPDI) **without dependencies**: the export writes tasks with WBS, outline levels, manual mode, constraints, deadlines and baselines, links with `LinkLag`, resources with max units, assignments with units and work, and the calendar (working weekdays + holiday exceptions), then downloads (`download: false` returns the XML only). The import parses with a small DOM-free reader (no Trusted Types sink, no DTD entities) into plain `tasks` / `dependencies` / `resources` / `workCalendar` in the default field names — bind them. Midnight-to-midnight dates map to 08:00–17:00 and back, so a round trip is lossless. MSPDI is direction-neutral data, so an RTL Gantt writes the same XML. |

#### Events

_Editing (cancelable pipeline)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onTaskInserting / onTaskUpdating / onTaskDeleting` | `(event: OgeGanttTask*ingEvent<T>) => void` | Cancelable pre-events — set `event.cancel = true` to veto before the store changes. |
| `onTaskInserted / onTaskUpdated / onTaskDeleted` | `(event: OgeGanttTask*edEvent<T>) => void` | Fired only for applied changes — persist from these. |
| `onDependencyInserting / onDependencyDeleting` | `(event: OgeGanttDependency*ingEvent) => void` | Cancelable link pre-events; inserting carries `predecessorKey`, `successorKey` and `type`. |
| `onDependencyInserted / onDependencyDeleted` | `(event: OgeGanttDependency*edEvent<D>) => void` | Applied link changes. |
| `onTaskEditDialogShowing` | `(event: OgeGanttDialogShowingEvent<T>) => void` | Cancelable, before the task dialog opens; replace `formItems` (React form items, render props allowed) to customize the form. |

_Interaction_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onTaskClick / onTaskDblClick / onTaskContextMenu` | `(event: OgeGanttTaskClickEvent<T>) => void` | Bar/row pointer events with the normalized task and the native `MouseEvent`. Right-click — or **Shift+F10** / the ContextMenu key on a row — also opens the **built-in context menu** (labels in `messages.menu`; Up/Down/Home/End move, Escape or the inline-start arrow closes it and returns to the row). |
| `onSelectionChanged` | `(event: OgeGanttSelectionChangedEvent<T>) => void` | Selection changed: `task` (the primary row, or `null`) and `tasks` (every selected task; multiple mode). |
| `onScaleTypeChange / onSelectedTaskKeyChange` | `(value: OgeGanttScaleType) / (key: RowKey \| null) => void` | The controlled halves of `scaleType` and `selectedTaskKey`. |

_Scheduling & task list_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onSchedulingConflict` | `OgeGanttSchedulingConflictEvent<T>` | The conflict set changed (also when it empties): `conflicts` with the task, the `kind` (`'dependency' \| 'constraint' \| 'deadline'`), the violated link / constraint / date and a readable `message`. Conflicted bars draw a dashed danger outline and a `!` badge; their row labels name the conflict. |
| `onDependencyUpdating / onDependencyUpdated` | `OgeGanttDependencyUpdat*Event<D>` | Cancelable link update (type / lag) and its applied twin. |
| `onSortChanged / onColumnResized / onColumnReordered` | `OgeGanttSortChangedEvent / OgeGanttColumnResizedEvent / OgeGanttColumnReorderedEvent` | Task-list state changes: `{ field, direction }` (`null` = cleared), `{ field, widthPx }`, `{ field, fromIndex, toIndex }`. |
| `onSelectedTaskKeysChange / onBaselineIndexChange / onViewModeChange` | `readonly RowKey[] / number / OgeGanttViewMode` | The controlled halves of `selectedTaskKeys`, `baselineIndex` and `viewMode`. |

#### Types

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeGanttHandle<T, D>` | `interface` | The `ref` handle: every method listed above. |
| `OgeGanttTask<T>` | `interface` | The normalized task — the payload of events and templates: `key`, `parentKey`, `source` (the original item), `title`, `start`/`end`, `progress`, `color`, baseline dates and `baselines`, `isSummary`/`isMilestone`, `level`, `wbs`, `manuallyScheduled`, `constraintType`/`constraintDate`, `deadline`, `segments`, `resourceIds` with aligned `units`, and `effort`. |
| `OgeGanttDependency<D>` | `interface` | The normalized link: `key`, `source`, `predecessorKey`, `successorKey`, `type`, `lag` (negative = lead) and `lagUnit`. |
| `OgeGanttDependencyType` | `'FS' \| 'SS' \| 'FF' \| 'SF'` | Finish-to-start, start-to-start, finish-to-finish, start-to-finish. |
| `OgeGanttScaleType` | `'hours' \| 'days' \| 'weeks' \| 'months' \| 'quarters' \| 'years'` | The timeline scale units. |
| `OgeGanttColumn` | `interface` | A task-list column: `{ field, header?, widthPx?, format?, editor?, allowSorting?, frozen? }`. |
| `OgeGanttStripLine` | `interface` | `{ start, end?, label?, color? }` — a chart marker line or range. |
| `OgeGanttWorkCalendar` | `interface` | `{ workingDays?, holidays? }` — the work-time calendar (0 = Sunday; default working week Monday-Friday). |
| `OgeGanttResource` | `interface` | `{ id, text, color?, calendar?, capacity? }` — one assignable resource (the `resources` item type); `capacity` (%, default 100) is the histogram's over-allocation line. |
| `OgeGanttExportData<T> / OgeGanttExportColumn<T>` | `interface` | The exporter snapshot: `tasks`, `columns` (header + pane-identical `text()`), `rangeStart`/`rangeEnd`, `critical` keys, `resourceText()`, and (optional, for hand-built snapshots) `dependencies`, `resources`, `workCalendar` and `slack`. |
| `OgeGanttTaskTitlePosition` | `'inside' \| 'outside' \| 'none'` | Task title placement relative to the bar. |
| `OgeGanttTaskRenderContext<T> / OgeGanttTooltipRenderContext<T>` | `interface` | The render-prop contexts: `{ task: OgeGanttTask<T> }`. |
| `OgeGanttConstraintType / OgeGanttLagUnit` | `'ASAP' \| 'ALAP' \| 'SNET' \| 'SNLT' \| 'FNET' \| 'FNLT' \| 'MSO' \| 'MFO' / 'days' \| 'hours'` | Constraint types and the lag unit. |
| `OgeGanttSegment / OgeGanttSlack` | `interface` | `{ start, end }` (split piece or baseline) / `{ totalSlack, freeSlack }` in days. |
| `OgeGanttZoomPreset` | `interface` | `{ scaleType, tickWidth?, label? }` — one zoom-chooser entry. |
| `OgeGanttSchedulingConflict<T> / OgeGanttConflictKind` | `interface` | `{ key, task, kind, constraintType?, dependencyKey?, date?, message }`. |
| `OgeGanttViewMode / OgeGanttSelectionMode / OgeGanttSortDirection / OgeGanttCellEditorType` | `string unions` | `'tasks' \| 'resources'`, `'single' \| 'multiple'`, `'asc' \| 'desc'`, `'text' \| 'number' \| 'date' \| 'duration' \| 'predecessor'`. |

### Configuration

#### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeGanttConfigProvider` | `<OgeGanttConfigProvider config>` | `—` | Configures every Gantt below it (`OgeGanttConfigInput`); shallow merge over the enclosing provider (or `OGE_DEFAULT_GANTT_CONFIG`) per top-level key — a partial `messages` replaces whole nested blocks. A new `config` object re-resolves, so switching the UI language at runtime is a state change. |
| `useOgeGanttConfig()` | `OgeGanttConfig` | `—` | The resolved Gantt config for the current subtree. |
| `messages` | `OgeGanttMessages` | `—` | Every user-facing string, aria labels included: `toolbar`, `menu`, `columns`, `dialog`, `grid` (aria templates with `{token}` placeholders) and `announcements` (live-region templates, ICU plurals for counts), plus the optional `scales`, `scheduling` and `dependencyEditor` blocks — keys added after 1.1 are optional and filled from English (`fillGanttMessages`). Defaults: `OGE_DEFAULT_GANTT_MESSAGES` — single-sourced in `@oge-ui/gantt-engine`, identical to the Angular catalog. |
| `locale` | `string \| undefined` | `—` | BCP 47 locale for every `Intl` format in scope; a per-instance `locale` prop wins. |
| `rowHeight` | `number` | `36` | Fixed row height in px — the invariant behind the row virtualization of both panes. |
| `undoLimit` | `number` | `50` | Undo history depth. |

## Demos

Each demo below is a complete standalone component — copy one whole and it compiles.

### MS Project XML

```ts
'use client';

import { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { OgeGantt } from '@oge-ui/react-gantt';
import type { OgeGanttHandle, OgeGanttResource, OgeGanttWorkCalendar } from '@oge-ui/react-gantt';

// /export-msproject has no dependencies: MSPDI XML with WBS, outline
// levels, manual mode, constraints, deadlines, baselines, links with lag,
// resources, assignments with units and the calendar. The import returns
// plain data in the default field names — set it as props.
type Item = Record<string, unknown>;

export function ProjectFiles() {
  const gantt = useRef<OgeGanttHandle<Item, Item>>(null);
  const [tasks, setTasks] = useState<Item[]>([
    { id: 1, title: 'Pack', start: new Date(2026, 7, 3), end: new Date(2026, 7, 6) },
    { id: 2, title: 'Move', start: new Date(2026, 7, 7), end: new Date(2026, 7, 8) },
  ]);
  const [links, setLinks] = useState<Item[]>([
    { id: 'a', predecessorId: 1, successorId: 2, lag: 1 },
  ]);
  const [resources, setResources] = useState<OgeGanttResource[]>([]);
  const [calendar, setCalendar] = useState<OgeGanttWorkCalendar | null>(null);

  const exportXml = async () => {
    const { exportGanttToMsProject } = await import('@oge-ui/react-gantt/export-msproject');
    if (gantt.current) {
      exportGanttToMsProject(gantt.current, { filename: 'plan.xml', title: 'Office move' });
    }
  };

  const importXml = async (file: File | undefined) => {
    if (!file) return;
    const { importMsProjectXml } = await import('@oge-ui/react-gantt/export-msproject');
    const plan = importMsProjectXml(await file.text());
    setTasks(plan.tasks as unknown as Item[]);
    setLinks(plan.dependencies as unknown as Item[]);
    setResources(plan.resources);
    setCalendar(plan.workCalendar);
  };
  return (
    <>
      <div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        <button type="button" onClick={exportXml}>Download .xml</button>
        <input type="file" accept=".xml" onChange={(event) => importXml(event.target.files?.[0])} />
      </div>
      <OgeGantt
        ref={gantt}
        tasks={tasks}
        dependencies={links}
        resources={resources}
        workCalendar={calendar}
        style={{ height: 420 }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

### Getting started

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeGantt } from '@oge-ui/react-gantt';

const tasks = [
  { id: 1, title: 'Release 1.0', start: new Date(2026, 7, 3), end: new Date(2026, 7, 21) },
  {
    id: 2,
    parentId: 1,
    title: 'Design',
    start: new Date(2026, 7, 3),
    end: new Date(2026, 7, 7),
    progress: 100,
  },
  {
    id: 3,
    parentId: 1,
    title: 'Implementation',
    start: new Date(2026, 7, 7),
    end: new Date(2026, 7, 17),
    progress: 45,
  },
  {
    id: 4,
    parentId: 1,
    title: 'Ship',
    start: new Date(2026, 7, 21),
    end: new Date(2026, 7, 21), // zero-length => milestone diamond
  },
];

const links = [
  { id: 'a', predecessorId: 2, successorId: 3 }, // FS is the default type
  { id: 'b', predecessorId: 3, successorId: 4 },
];

export function ReleasePlan() {
  return (
    // One component, a working Gantt: task tree pane + timeline chart with
    // summary brackets, milestone diamonds and dependency arrows. Drag a bar to
    // move it (Escape cancels mid-drag), pull its edges to resize, drag the
    // bottom knob to set progress, drag a link dot onto another bar to draw a
    // dependency. Double-click opens the task dialog.
    <OgeGantt tasks={tasks} dependencies={links} style={{ height: 480 }} />
  );
}
```

### Field mapping

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeGantt } from '@oge-ui/react-gantt';

const workItems = [
  {
    code: 'EPIC-1',
    subject: 'Checkout revamp',
    plan: { begin: '2026-08-03', finish: '2026-08-14' },
  },
  {
    code: 'T-1',
    parentCode: 'EPIC-1',
    subject: 'Payment API',
    plan: { begin: '2026-08-03', finish: '2026-08-07' },
    done: 80,
  },
  {
    code: 'T-2',
    parentCode: 'EPIC-1',
    subject: 'Wallet UI',
    plan: { begin: '2026-08-07', finish: '2026-08-14' },
    done: 20,
  },
];

const relations = [{ relId: 1, fromCode: 'T-1', toCode: 'T-2' }];

export function MappedPlan() {
  return (
    // Any item shape binds through the *Expr props — field names, dotted
    // paths or getter functions — for tasks AND dependency links. String dates
    // parse as local wall time and write back in the same storage shape after
    // edits.
    <OgeGantt
      tasks={workItems}
      dependencies={relations}
      keyExpr="code"
      parentKeyExpr="parentCode"
      titleExpr="subject"
      startExpr="plan.begin"
      endExpr="plan.finish"
      progressExpr="done"
      dependencyKeyExpr="relId"
      predecessorKeyExpr="fromCode"
      successorKeyExpr="toCode"
      style={{ height: 360 }}
    />
  );
}
```

### Dependencies & critical path

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeGantt } from '@oge-ui/react-gantt';

const tasks = [
  { id: 1, title: 'Foundation', start: new Date(2026, 7, 3), end: new Date(2026, 7, 6), progress: 100 },
  { id: 2, title: 'Framing', start: new Date(2026, 7, 6), end: new Date(2026, 7, 12), progress: 60 },
  { id: 3, title: 'Electrical', start: new Date(2026, 7, 12), end: new Date(2026, 7, 15) },
  { id: 4, title: 'Landscaping', start: new Date(2026, 7, 6), end: new Date(2026, 7, 10) },
  { id: 5, title: 'Inspection', start: new Date(2026, 7, 17), end: new Date(2026, 7, 18) },
];

const links = [
  { id: 1, predecessorId: 1, successorId: 2 },
  { id: 2, predecessorId: 2, successorId: 3 },
  { id: 3, predecessorId: 3, successorId: 5 },
  { id: 4, predecessorId: 4, successorId: 5 },
];

export function CriticalPlan() {
  return (
    // showCriticalPath outlines the tasks with zero slack; autoScheduling
    // pushes successors forward whenever a predecessor moves (FS/SS/FF/SF
    // respected). Drawing a link that would close a cycle is rejected and
    // announced — try dragging a link dot backwards.
    <OgeGantt
      tasks={tasks}
      dependencies={links}
      showCriticalPath
      autoScheduling
      style={{ height: 420 }}
    />
  );
}
```

### Editing pipeline

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeGantt } from '@oge-ui/react-gantt';
import type { OgeGanttTaskDeletingEvent, OgeGanttTaskUpdatingEvent } from '@oge-ui/react-gantt';

type DemoTask = Record<string, unknown>;

const tasks: DemoTask[] = [
  { id: 1, title: 'Audit (done — locked)', start: new Date(2026, 7, 3), end: new Date(2026, 7, 6), progress: 100 },
  { id: 2, title: 'Remediation', start: new Date(2026, 7, 6), end: new Date(2026, 7, 13), progress: 30 },
];

const protectDone = (event: OgeGanttTaskUpdatingEvent<DemoTask>) => {
  if ((event.oldData['progress'] as number) === 100) event.cancel = true;
};

const confirmDelete = (event: OgeGanttTaskDeletingEvent<DemoTask>) => {
  event.cancel = !confirm('Delete this task?');
};

export function GuardedPlan() {
  return (
    // Every mutation runs a cancelable '-ing' callback before the store
    // changes; the past-tense callback fires only for applied changes — persist
    // from there. allow* props gate each capability; readOnly turns the whole
    // widget display-only. This demo protects finished tasks and asks before
    // deleting.
    <OgeGantt
      tasks={tasks}
      allowDependencyAdding={false}
      onTaskUpdating={protectDone}
      onTaskDeleting={confirmDelete}
      style={{ height: 360 }}
    />
  );
}
```

### Toolbar, scales & undo/redo

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeGantt } from '@oge-ui/react-gantt';
import type { OgeGanttScaleType } from '@oge-ui/react-gantt';

const columns = [
  { field: 'title' },
  { field: 'progress' },
  { field: 'owner', header: 'Owner' },
];

const tasks = [
  { id: 1, title: 'Discovery', start: new Date(2026, 6, 6), end: new Date(2026, 6, 24), progress: 100, owner: 'Ada' },
  { id: 2, title: 'Build', start: new Date(2026, 6, 27), end: new Date(2026, 8, 4), progress: 40, owner: 'Grace' },
  { id: 3, title: 'Rollout', start: new Date(2026, 8, 7), end: new Date(2026, 8, 25), owner: 'Ada' },
];

export function ZoomablePlan() {
  // scaleType is a controlled pair — the toolbar zoom writes it back
  const [scale, setScale] = useState<OgeGanttScaleType>('weeks');
  return (
    // The toolbar adds tasks, zooms between hour/day/week/month scales
    // (Ctrl+wheel on the chart works too), fits the whole plan,
    // expands/collapses the tree and drives snapshot undo/redo — every edit,
    // including drags, is one undo step. The task list is a virtualized
    // treegrid: columns are configurable and the splitter between the panes
    // drags.
    <OgeGantt
      tasks={tasks}
      scaleType={scale}
      onScaleTypeChange={setScale}
      columns={columns}
      taskListWidth={300}
      style={{ height: 420 }}
    />
  );
}
```

### Work calendar, teams & export

```ts
'use client';

import { useRef } from 'react';
import { OgeGantt } from '@oge-ui/react-gantt';
import type { OgeGanttHandle, OgeGanttWorkCalendar } from '@oge-ui/react-gantt';

type DemoTask = Record<string, unknown>;

const calendar: OgeGanttWorkCalendar = {
  workingDays: [1, 2, 3, 4], // four-day week
  holidays: [new Date(2026, 7, 12)],
};

const people = [
  { id: 'ada', text: 'Ada', color: '#7c3aed' },
  {
    id: 'grace',
    text: 'Grace',
    color: '#0891b2',
    // per-resource calendar: overrides workCalendar for Grace's tasks
    calendar: { workingDays: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] },
  },
];

const tasks: DemoTask[] = [
  {
    id: 1,
    title: 'Prototype',
    start: new Date(2026, 7, 3),
    end: new Date(2026, 7, 6),
    progress: 80,
    resourceId: ['ada', 'grace'], // multi-assignment
  },
  {
    id: 2,
    title: 'Field test',
    start: new Date(2026, 7, 6),
    end: new Date(2026, 7, 11),
    resourceId: 'grace',
  },
];

const links: DemoTask[] = [{ id: 1, predecessorId: 1, successorId: 2 }];

export function TeamPlan() {
  const plan = useRef<OgeGanttHandle<DemoTask, DemoTask>>(null);

  /** exceljs stays out of the initial bundle — loaded on first click. */
  const exportExcel = async () => {
    const { exportGanttToExcel } = await import('@oge-ui/react-gantt/export-excel');
    if (plan.current) await exportGanttToExcel(plan.current, { filename: 'plan.xlsx' });
  };

  /** jspdf loads lazily the same way. */
  const exportPdf = async () => {
    const { exportGanttToPdf } = await import('@oge-ui/react-gantt/export-pdf');
    if (plan.current) await exportGanttToPdf(plan.current, { filename: 'plan.pdf', title: 'Plan' });
  };

  /** PNG needs no third-party library at all — plain canvas drawing. */
  const exportPng = async () => {
    const { exportGanttToPng } = await import('@oge-ui/react-gantt/export-image');
    if (plan.current) await exportGanttToPng(plan.current, { filename: 'plan.png' });
  };
  return (
    <>
      {/* workCalendar shades every off day (custom working week + holidays)
          and makes auto-scheduling roll pushed starts onto working days,
          preserving durations in working days. resourceId may hold an ARRAY of
          ids — the dialog edits assignments with a tag editor and the bar label
          joins the names. The export entry points load exceljs/jspdf lazily:
          Excel writes the task tree as a typed worksheet, PDF draws the chart
          as vector graphics. */}
      <div className="mb-2 flex gap-2">
        <button type="button" onClick={exportExcel}>Export Excel</button>
        <button type="button" onClick={exportPdf}>Export PDF</button>
        <button type="button" onClick={exportPng}>Export PNG</button>
      </div>
      <OgeGantt
        ref={plan}
        tasks={tasks}
        dependencies={links}
        resources={people}
        workCalendar={calendar}
        showResourceWorkload
        autoScheduling
        style={{ height: 400 }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

### Task template

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeGantt } from '@oge-ui/react-gantt';

const tasks = [
  { id: 1, title: 'Usability study', start: new Date(2026, 7, 3), end: new Date(2026, 7, 12), progress: 55, color: '#0f766e' },
  { id: 2, title: 'Findings report', start: new Date(2026, 7, 12), end: new Date(2026, 7, 17), progress: 10 },
];

export function TemplatedPlan() {
  return (
    // renderTask replaces the bar's title content; renderTooltip replaces the
    // hover tooltip (default: title, dates + duration, progress, resources).
    // Bar surface, gestures and keyboard semantics stay with the component.
    <OgeGantt
      tasks={tasks}
      style={{ height: 300 }}
      renderTask={({ task }) => (
        <>
          <strong>{task.title}</strong>
          <span className="opacity-75"> · {task.progress}%</span>
        </>
      )}
      renderTooltip={({ task }) => (
        <>
          <strong>{task.title}</strong>
          <em>{task.progress}% complete</em>
        </>
      )}
    />
  );
}
```

### Configuration & i18n

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeGantt, OgeGanttConfigProvider } from '@oge-ui/react-gantt';

const tasks = [
  { id: 1, title: 'Planung', start: new Date(2026, 7, 3), end: new Date(2026, 7, 10), progress: 25 },
];

export function LocalizedPlan() {
  return (
    <>
      {/* Every user-facing string, aria labels included, lives in
          OgeGanttMessages — provide once with <OgeGanttConfigProvider> (a new
          config object re-resolves, so switching the UI language is a state
          change) or override per instance with messages. locale drives every
          Intl date format; rowHeight and undoLimit are config-level too. */}
      {/* App-wide, e.g. around the router:
          config={{ locale: 'de', rowHeight: 32, messages: { toolbar: { ...germanToolbar } } }} */}
      <OgeGanttConfigProvider config={{ locale: 'de' }}>
        <OgeGantt tasks={tasks} locale="de" style={{ height: 300 }} />
      </OgeGanttConfigProvider>
    </>
  );
}
```

### RTL

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeGantt } from '@oge-ui/react-gantt';

const tasks = [
  { id: 1, title: 'Release 1.0', start: new Date(2026, 7, 3), end: new Date(2026, 7, 21) },
  { id: 2, parentId: 1, title: 'Design', start: new Date(2026, 7, 3), end: new Date(2026, 7, 7), progress: 100 },
  { id: 3, parentId: 1, title: 'Implementation', start: new Date(2026, 7, 7), end: new Date(2026, 7, 17), progress: 45 },
  { id: 4, parentId: 1, title: 'Ship', start: new Date(2026, 7, 21), end: new Date(2026, 7, 21) },
];

const links = [
  { id: 'a', predecessorId: 2, successorId: 3 },
  { id: 'b', predecessorId: 3, successorId: 4 },
];

export function RtlPlan() {
  return (
    <>
      {/* rtlEnabled (unset = follow the page's dir) mirrors the whole chart:
          the task tree sits on the right, the timeline runs right to left,
          dependency arrows and drags follow, and the Left/Right keys swap —
          Left expands a summary, Alt+Shift+Left indents, Ctrl+Left moves a
          bar later. */}
      <OgeGantt tasks={tasks} dependencies={links} rtlEnabled style={{ height: 300 }} />
    </>
  );
}
```

### Units, work & utilization

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeGantt } from '@oge-ui/react-gantt';
import type { OgeGanttColumn, OgeGanttResource } from '@oge-ui/react-gantt';

// units (%) per assignment, work in hours and effortDriven: changing a
// task's people, units or work recomputes its finish. The histogram sums
// units per period against each resource's capacity line — over-allocated
// periods turn red.
const columns: OgeGanttColumn[] = [
  { field: 'title' },
  { field: 'resources' },
  { field: 'units' },
  { field: 'effort' },
];
const resources: OgeGanttResource[] = [
  { id: 1, text: 'Ana' },
  { id: 2, text: 'Bora', capacity: 50 }, // half time
  { id: 3, text: 'Cem' },
];
const tasks = [
  { id: 1, title: 'API design', start: new Date(2026, 7, 3), end: new Date(2026, 7, 7), resourceId: [1], effort: 32 },
  {
    id: 2,
    title: 'Database',
    start: new Date(2026, 7, 5),
    end: new Date(2026, 7, 11),
    resourceId: [1, 2],
    units: [50, 100], // per assignment, in %
    effort: 40,
  },
  { id: 3, title: 'Monitoring', start: new Date(2026, 7, 6), end: new Date(2026, 7, 10), resourceId: [2], effort: 16 },
  { id: 4, title: 'Load tests', start: new Date(2026, 7, 11), end: new Date(2026, 7, 14), resourceId: [3], effort: 24 },
];

export function Utilization() {
  return (
    <OgeGantt
      tasks={tasks}
      resources={resources}
      columns={columns}
      effortDriven
      hoursPerDay={8}
      showResourceHistogram
      style={{ height: 460 }}
    />
  );
}
```

### Resource view

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeGantt } from '@oge-ui/react-gantt';
import type { OgeGanttResource, OgeGanttViewMode } from '@oge-ui/react-gantt';

// viewMode 'resources' regroups the rows by resource (the toolbar's
// Resource view toggle flips it); assignment rows edit the real task.
const resources: OgeGanttResource[] = [
  { id: 1, text: 'Ana' },
  { id: 2, text: 'Bora', capacity: 50 }, // half time
  { id: 3, text: 'Cem' },
];
const tasks = [
  { id: 1, title: 'API design', start: new Date(2026, 7, 3), end: new Date(2026, 7, 7), resourceId: [1], effort: 32 },
  {
    id: 2,
    title: 'Database',
    start: new Date(2026, 7, 5),
    end: new Date(2026, 7, 11),
    resourceId: [1, 2],
    units: [50, 100], // per assignment, in %
    effort: 40,
  },
  { id: 3, title: 'Monitoring', start: new Date(2026, 7, 6), end: new Date(2026, 7, 10), resourceId: [2], effort: 16 },
  { id: 4, title: 'Load tests', start: new Date(2026, 7, 11), end: new Date(2026, 7, 14), resourceId: [3], effort: 24 },
];

export function ByPerson() {
  const [view, setView] = useState<OgeGanttViewMode>('resources');
  return (
    <>
      <OgeGantt
        tasks={tasks}
        resources={resources}
        viewMode={view}
        onViewModeChange={setView}
        style={{ height: 420 }}
      />
      <p>View: {view}</p>
    </>
  );
}
```

### Lag, lead & slack

```ts
'use client';

import { useRef } from 'react';
import { OgeGantt } from '@oge-ui/react-gantt';
import type { OgeGanttColumn, OgeGanttHandle, OgeGanttWorkCalendar } from '@oge-ui/react-gantt';

// lag (negative = lead) on any link type, in working days on the
// calendar or in hours; auto-scheduling pulls tasks earlier as well as
// pushing them later. Edit a link: double-click its arrow, or type "2FS+2d"
// into the Predecessors cell.
type Task = Record<string, unknown>;

const calendar: OgeGanttWorkCalendar = { workingDays: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] };
const columns: OgeGanttColumn[] = [
  { field: 'wbs' },
  { field: 'title' },
  { field: 'start' },
  { field: 'predecessors' },
  { field: 'totalSlack' },
  { field: 'freeSlack' },
];
const tasks: Task[] = [
  { id: 1, title: 'Specs', start: new Date(2026, 7, 3), end: new Date(2026, 7, 7) },
  { id: 2, title: 'Prototype', start: new Date(2026, 7, 12), end: new Date(2026, 7, 19) },
  { id: 3, title: 'User tests', start: new Date(2026, 7, 17), end: new Date(2026, 7, 21) },
  { id: 4, title: 'Release', start: new Date(2026, 7, 28), end: new Date(2026, 7, 28) },
];
const links = [
  { id: 'a', predecessorId: 1, successorId: 2, lag: 2 }, // FS + 2 working days
  { id: 'b', predecessorId: 2, successorId: 3, type: 'SS', lag: 3 },
  { id: 'c', predecessorId: 3, successorId: 4, lag: 4, lagUnit: 'hours' },
];

export function LaggedPlan() {
  const gantt = useRef<OgeGanttHandle<Task>>(null);
  return (
    <>
      <button type="button" onClick={() => gantt.current?.scheduleProject()}>
        Recalculate
      </button>
      <OgeGantt
        ref={gantt}
        tasks={tasks}
        dependencies={links}
        columns={columns}
        workCalendar={calendar}
        autoScheduling
        showCriticalPath
        inlineEditing
        style={{ height: 420 }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

### Constraints, deadlines & conflicts

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeGantt } from '@oge-ui/react-gantt';
import type { OgeGanttColumn } from '@oge-ui/react-gantt';

// constraintType + constraintDate (ASAP, ALAP, SNET, SNLT, FNET, FNLT,
// MSO, MFO), a deadline marker and manual tasks the engine never moves.
// Whatever cannot be satisfied comes back as a conflict: a dashed outline,
// a "!" badge, the row label — and onSchedulingConflict.
const columns: OgeGanttColumn[] = [
  { field: 'title', widthPx: 200 },
  { field: 'constraint' },
  { field: 'deadline' },
];
const tasks = [
  { id: 1, title: 'Backend', start: new Date(2026, 7, 3), end: new Date(2026, 7, 12) },
  {
    id: 2,
    title: 'Security review',
    start: new Date(2026, 7, 3),
    end: new Date(2026, 7, 5),
    constraintType: 'SNET',
    constraintDate: new Date(2026, 7, 10),
  },
  {
    id: 3,
    title: 'Frontend',
    start: new Date(2026, 7, 12),
    end: new Date(2026, 7, 19),
    deadline: new Date(2026, 7, 18),
  },
  { id: 4, title: 'Translations', start: new Date(2026, 7, 3), end: new Date(2026, 7, 5), constraintType: 'ALAP' },
  {
    id: 5,
    title: 'Vendor install',
    start: new Date(2026, 7, 10),
    end: new Date(2026, 7, 12),
    manuallyScheduled: true,
  },
];
const links = [
  { id: 'a', predecessorId: 1, successorId: 3 },
  { id: 'b', predecessorId: 1, successorId: 5 }, // the manual task breaks this link
];

export function ConstrainedPlan() {
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<string[]>([]);
  return (
    <>
      <OgeGantt
        tasks={tasks}
        dependencies={links}
        columns={columns}
        autoScheduling
        style={{ height: 420 }}
        onSchedulingConflict={(event) =>
          setMessages(event.conflicts.map((conflict) => conflict.message))
        }
      />
      <ul aria-live="polite">
        {messages.map((message) => (
          <li key={message}>{message}</li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </>
  );
}
```

### Baselines, split tasks & progress line

```ts
'use client';

import { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { OgeGantt } from '@oge-ui/react-gantt';
import type { OgeGanttHandle } from '@oge-ui/react-gantt';

// several baselines (toolbar chooser), a split task, the progress line
// through the status date and child milestones rolled up onto the summary
// bar. setBaseline(i) saves the current dates as baseline i.
type Task = Record<string, unknown>;

const statusDate = new Date(2026, 7, 14);
const tasks: Task[] = [
  { id: 1, title: 'Migration', start: new Date(2026, 7, 3), end: new Date(2026, 7, 3) },
  {
    id: 2,
    parentId: 1,
    title: 'Inventory',
    start: new Date(2026, 7, 3),
    end: new Date(2026, 7, 7),
    progress: 100,
    baselines: [
      { start: new Date(2026, 7, 3), end: new Date(2026, 7, 6) },
      { start: new Date(2026, 7, 4), end: new Date(2026, 7, 7) },
    ],
  },
  { id: 3, parentId: 1, title: 'Plan approved', start: new Date(2026, 7, 7), end: new Date(2026, 7, 7) },
  {
    id: 4,
    parentId: 1,
    title: 'Data copy',
    start: new Date(2026, 7, 10),
    end: new Date(2026, 7, 19),
    progress: 50,
    segments: [
      { start: new Date(2026, 7, 10), end: new Date(2026, 7, 13) },
      { start: new Date(2026, 7, 17), end: new Date(2026, 7, 19) },
    ],
  },
];
const links = [
  { id: 'a', predecessorId: 2, successorId: 3 },
  { id: 'b', predecessorId: 3, successorId: 4, lag: 1 },
];

export function TrackedPlan() {
  const gantt = useRef<OgeGanttHandle<Task>>(null);
  const [baseline, setBaseline] = useState(0);
  return (
    <>
      <button type="button" onClick={() => gantt.current?.setBaseline(2)}>
        Save as baseline 3
      </button>
      <OgeGantt
        ref={gantt}
        tasks={tasks}
        dependencies={links}
        showProgressLine
        statusDate={statusDate}
        showRollups
        baselineIndex={baseline}
        onBaselineIndexChange={setBaseline}
        style={{ height: 360 }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

### Quarter & year scales

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeGantt } from '@oge-ui/react-gantt';
import type { OgeGanttScaleType, OgeGanttZoomPreset } from '@oge-ui/react-gantt';

// quarters and years extend the zoom ladder; zoomPresets fills the
// toolbar's scale chooser (a scale plus an optional tick width).
const presets: OgeGanttZoomPreset[] = [
  { scaleType: 'weeks', label: 'Sprint view' },
  { scaleType: 'months', tickWidth: 64, label: 'Compact months' },
  { scaleType: 'quarters', label: 'Quarters' },
  { scaleType: 'years', label: 'Roadmap (years)' },
];
const tasks = [
  { id: 1, title: 'Platform v2', start: new Date(2026, 0, 12), end: new Date(2026, 5, 30) },
  { id: 2, title: 'Mobile apps', start: new Date(2026, 3, 1), end: new Date(2026, 11, 18) },
  { id: 3, title: 'EU region', start: new Date(2026, 8, 1), end: new Date(2027, 2, 31) },
];

export function Roadmap() {
  const [scale, setScale] = useState<OgeGanttScaleType>('quarters');
  return (
    <OgeGantt
      tasks={tasks}
      zoomPresets={presets}
      scaleType={scale}
      onScaleTypeChange={setScale}
      style={{ height: 300 }}
    />
  );
}
```

### Inline editing

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeGantt } from '@oge-ui/react-gantt';
import type { OgeGanttColumn } from '@oge-ui/react-gantt';

// inlineEditing: double-click a cell or press F2 on a row; Enter
// commits, Escape cancels, Tab / Shift+Tab move along the row. Every commit
// runs the cancelable update pipeline and is one undo step.
type Task = Record<string, unknown>;

const columns: OgeGanttColumn[] = [
  { field: 'wbs', editor: false },
  { field: 'title' },
  { field: 'start' },
  { field: 'duration' },
  { field: 'progress' },
  { field: 'predecessors' },
  { field: 'owner' }, // a data field: a text editor by default
];
const tasks: Task[] = [
  { id: 1, title: 'Discovery', start: new Date(2026, 7, 3), end: new Date(2026, 7, 3) },
  { id: 2, parentId: 1, title: 'Interviews', start: new Date(2026, 7, 3), end: new Date(2026, 7, 6), owner: 'Ana' },
  { id: 3, parentId: 1, title: 'Survey', start: new Date(2026, 7, 4), end: new Date(2026, 7, 8), owner: 'Bora' },
  { id: 4, title: 'Delivery', start: new Date(2026, 7, 10), end: new Date(2026, 7, 10) },
  { id: 5, parentId: 4, title: 'Build', start: new Date(2026, 7, 10), end: new Date(2026, 7, 14), owner: 'Cem' },
  { id: 6, parentId: 4, title: 'Review', start: new Date(2026, 7, 14), end: new Date(2026, 7, 15), owner: 'Ana' },
];
const links = [{ id: 'a', predecessorId: 5, successorId: 6 }];

export function EditableList() {
  return (
    <OgeGantt
      tasks={tasks}
      dependencies={links}
      columns={columns}
      inlineEditing
      style={{ height: 360 }}
    />
  );
}
```

### Sort, filter & columns

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeGantt } from '@oge-ui/react-gantt';
import type { OgeGanttColumn, OgeGanttSortChangedEvent } from '@oge-ui/react-gantt';

// header click / Enter sorts siblings; the filter row and the search box
// keep the ancestors of matches. Drag a header edge (Alt+Arrow) to resize,
// drag a header (Ctrl+Shift+Arrow) to move it; frozen columns stay pinned
// while the pane scrolls sideways.
type Task = Record<string, unknown>;

const columns: OgeGanttColumn[] = [
  { field: 'wbs', frozen: true, allowSorting: false },
  { field: 'title', frozen: true },
  { field: 'owner' },
  { field: 'start' },
  { field: 'end' },
  { field: 'duration' },
];
const tasks: Task[] = [
  { id: 1, title: 'Discovery', start: new Date(2026, 7, 3), end: new Date(2026, 7, 3) },
  { id: 2, parentId: 1, title: 'Interviews', start: new Date(2026, 7, 3), end: new Date(2026, 7, 6), owner: 'Ana' },
  { id: 3, parentId: 1, title: 'Survey', start: new Date(2026, 7, 4), end: new Date(2026, 7, 8), owner: 'Bora' },
  { id: 4, title: 'Delivery', start: new Date(2026, 7, 10), end: new Date(2026, 7, 10) },
  { id: 5, parentId: 4, title: 'Build', start: new Date(2026, 7, 10), end: new Date(2026, 7, 14), owner: 'Cem' },
  { id: 6, parentId: 4, title: 'Review', start: new Date(2026, 7, 14), end: new Date(2026, 7, 15), owner: 'Ana' },
];
const links = [{ id: 'a', predecessorId: 5, successorId: 6 }];

export function SortableList() {
  const [lastSort, setLastSort] = useState<OgeGanttSortChangedEvent | null>(null);
  return (
    <>
      <OgeGantt
        tasks={tasks}
        dependencies={links}
        columns={columns}
        allowSorting
        allowColumnResizing
        allowColumnReordering
        filterRow
        searchPanel
        style={{ height: 400 }}
        onSortChanged={setLastSort}
      />
      <p>Sorted by: {lastSort?.field ?? 'store order'}</p>
    </>
  );
}
```

### Multi-select & bulk edits

```ts
'use client';

import { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { OgeGantt } from '@oge-ui/react-gantt';
import type { RowKey } from '@oge-ui/core';
import type { OgeGanttHandle } from '@oge-ui/react-gantt';

// selectionMode 'multiple': Ctrl/Cmd-click toggles, Shift-click and
// Shift+Up/Down extend, Ctrl+A selects all. Delete, Alt+Shift+Left/Right and
// the context menu act on the whole selection — one undo step.
type Task = Record<string, unknown>;

const tasks: Task[] = [
  { id: 1, title: 'Discovery', start: new Date(2026, 7, 3), end: new Date(2026, 7, 3) },
  { id: 2, parentId: 1, title: 'Interviews', start: new Date(2026, 7, 3), end: new Date(2026, 7, 6), owner: 'Ana' },
  { id: 3, parentId: 1, title: 'Survey', start: new Date(2026, 7, 4), end: new Date(2026, 7, 8), owner: 'Bora' },
  { id: 4, title: 'Delivery', start: new Date(2026, 7, 10), end: new Date(2026, 7, 10) },
  { id: 5, parentId: 4, title: 'Build', start: new Date(2026, 7, 10), end: new Date(2026, 7, 14), owner: 'Cem' },
  { id: 6, parentId: 4, title: 'Review', start: new Date(2026, 7, 14), end: new Date(2026, 7, 15), owner: 'Ana' },
];
const links = [{ id: 'a', predecessorId: 5, successorId: 6 }];

export function BulkEdits() {
  const gantt = useRef<OgeGanttHandle<Task>>(null);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<readonly RowKey[]>([]);

  const indent = () => {
    const handle = gantt.current;
    if (handle) handle.indentTasks(handle.getSelectedTasks());
  };
  const remove = () => {
    const handle = gantt.current;
    if (handle) handle.deleteTasks(handle.getSelectedTasks().map((task) => task.source));
  };
  return (
    <>
      <button type="button" onClick={indent}>Indent selected</button>
      <button type="button" onClick={remove}>Delete selected</button>
      <OgeGantt
        ref={gantt}
        tasks={tasks}
        dependencies={links}
        selectionMode="multiple"
        selectedTaskKeys={selected}
        onSelectedTaskKeysChange={setSelected}
        style={{ height: 360 }}
      />
      <p>{selected.length} selected</p>
    </>
  );
}
```
